about: Ground truth measured in session 50a7c16b on 2026-09-18 (ORCH-1020). Role-worded: no repository source, no paths, no names. Labels are facts from the orchestrator's own mutation runs and verification outcomes, fixed before any model was asked.

A_mutation_triage.instructions: Given a rule a function enforces, the names of its tests, and a described mutation of the function, decide whether at least one listed test would fail under the mutation. Judge only from the test names and what each plausibly checks.
A_mutation_triage.true: at least one listed test directly exercises the behaviour the mutation changes, so it would fail
A_mutation_triage.false: no listed test exercises the changed behaviour, or the mutation changes nothing observable, so every test still passes

items.rule: verify() raises KeyError when the binding lacks any pinned field
items.mutation: the missing-field check is disabled and a missing field reads as unchanged

items.rule: retry_budget refuses when previous >= ceiling, and separately refuses when the computed retry equals the previous budget
items.mutation: the first check changes from >= to >; the second check still refuses the equal case with the same exception

items.rule: a model profile must contain context_tokens and reasoning, else UnknownModel
items.mutation: the profile check only verifies the profile is a dict

items.rule: acquire is all or nothing: keys taken earlier in a failed call are released
items.mutation: the rollback is handed an empty set, releasing nothing

items.rule: a policy entry given as a bare string is one model id, never iterated character by character
items.mutation: the bare-string guard is removed and matching becomes substring

items.rule: a grant whose expiry equals now is expired
items.mutation: the expiry comparison changes from <= to <

items.rule: a run id is refused if it is empty, contains whitespace, or contains a path separator
items.mutation: the path-separator check is deleted

items.rule: a feature record is refused if any of eight required fields is missing: measurable_outcome, baseline, expected_mechanism, exact_files, done_check, negative_done_check, evidence_artifact, rollback
items.mutation: evidence_artifact is no longer required (still accepted when present)

items.rule: the boundary's network call treats an undeclared autonomy as high autonomy
items.mutation: the boundary's default for undeclared autonomy becomes supervised

items.rule: the unknown risk bucket must never share a name with a real risk class (real classes include low, normal, medium, high, critical)
items.mutation: the unknown bucket is renamed low

items.rule: an identity may not contain a path separator; checked by a character pattern and again by an explicit separator check
items.mutation: the character pattern starts allowing '/', the explicit separator check is unchanged

items.rule: an unknown change type raises, never maps to the weakest obligation
items.mutation: an unknown change type returns the weakest registered obligation

items.rule: a digest mismatch in a fresh clone is FAIL, not NO-DATA
items.mutation: a failed verification returns NO-DATA instead of FAIL

items.rule: a credential whose expiry equals now is refused
items.mutation: the expiry comparison changes from >= to >

items.rule: an unreadable process table reports containment unverified
items.mutation: an unreadable table reports contained and verified

items.rule: a claim of enforced needs non-blank evidence, else it is downgraded to advisory
items.mutation: whitespace-only evidence counts as evidence

items.rule: the first route whose required capabilities are all enforced is chosen, else the restrictive fallback
items.mutation: every route's requirements are ignored

items.rule: an intervention with an unknown category is refused before writing
items.mutation: the category check is disabled

items.rule: a dependents scan that could not complete counts as not clear
items.mutation: an incomplete scan (NO-DATA) counts as clear

items.rule: a high-autonomy caller in unrestricted mode needs an acknowledgement
items.mutation: the acknowledgement requirement is skipped for high autonomy

items.rule: a metric record may not demote itself out of the registry's mandatory set
items.mutation: the self-demotion refusal is removed

items.rule: two units owning the same path are both flagged
items.mutation: a collision is flagged only when three units share a path

items.rule: an unknown autonomy level refuses
items.mutation: an unknown level is treated as requiring no capabilities

items.rule: zero accepted units yields zero useful minutes
items.mutation: the gate changes from accepted > 0 to accepted >= 0

B_unknown_reads_safe.instructions: Read the rule. Decide whether a missing, unknown, undeclared or unreadable input ends up treated as the passing, permitted or safe outcome.
B_unknown_reads_safe.true: some missing, unknown, undeclared or unreadable input leads to a pass, an allow, a clean result or a score
B_unknown_reads_safe.false: every missing, unknown, undeclared or unreadable input leads to a refusal, a block, an error or an explicit no-data result

items.rule: Evidence is FRESH unless it predates the source's last edit time (when a source is given) or is older than a maximum age (when one is given).
decide(host, config, high_autonomy=False): in unrestricted mode the request is allowed without acknowledgement unless high_autonomy is true.
Each metric record states whether it is mandatory. A composite score is produced when every record marked mandatory has a measured value.
When the requested model fails, the next model in a fallback chain answers and the call exits 0 with that answer.
If no metric is mandatory and none is measured, the report prints SCORED.
report_line(result) prints accepted units and minutes, using 0 for any key missing from the result.
Compare the generated files expected by the registry with the files present in the destination directory; report each difference. A destination directory that does not exist has no files to compare.
tick() calls the arm function and records the episode as armed whenever that call does not raise.
An unknown change type raises an error; it is never mapped to the weakest obligation.
If the process table cannot be read, the result says containment is unverified.
An unknown platform returns NO-DATA and is never treated as POSIX.
If the bridge source holds several different default model assignments, the check refuses rather than picking one.
An autonomy level not present in the table is refused.
A credential whose expiry is at or before now is refused, and a missing store entry is refused.
A dependents scan that could not complete is treated as not clear, so nothing is deleted.
A feature record missing any of its eight required fields is refused.
Effort above the cap needs an unexpired grant quoting the founder; a missing, expired or self-authored grant refuses.
Evidence with no readable timestamp is NO-DATA; evidence with no source and no maximum age is NO-DATA.
A decision request whose answer lacks any asked question exits with an error and never falls back to another model.
A restart slot whose bound transcript does not exist declines to fire and logs why.

C_routing.instructions: Read the specification of a small module a drafting model will write and a second model will integrate. Predict whether the integrated result will pass its tests and hold up, or whether a later reviewer will find a defect that needs a fix.

criteria.clean: lands with only light integration; a later reviewer finds nothing wrong
criteria.needs_fix: a later reviewer finds a real defect: an unknown or missing input read as the safe case, an untested rule, or a flaky behaviour

D_log_triage.instructions: This is one line from a release pipeline's gate output. Classify what the release process should do about it.

criteria.blocking: this line means a gate failed and the release must stop until it is fixed
criteria.warning: something is off and worth a human look, but the release may continue
criteria.info: a pass, a skip that is expected, or a normal status; no action needed
